We retrieved template 1914393. It includes retro_smarts_template (forward? Actually retro). We need to propose retrosynthesis route using templates 1914393, then 1914394, then 1914395 in this order. So we need to apply them sequentially to break the target into precursors.

We need to apply template 1914393 to target SMILES COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1.

We need to use apply_template tool to get precursors. Let's do that.
